editorial:
Imagine having your whole world flip upside down in a single afternoon. You meet Pietro, a guy who seems to have it all—a great job, a loving wife, and a sweet daughter. But after a random act of kindness at the beach, he comes home to find out his wife is gone. The movie follows his struggle to keep it together for his daughter, Claudia. It has a very soft, emotional feel that focuses on how people deal with loss. You will feel for Pietro as he starts spending his entire day waiting outside his daughter's school just to make sure she feels safe and loved.

The acting is really natural and makes the sad parts feel real without being too over the top. While the story moves a bit slow at times, it gives you room to breathe and think about the characters. If you like stories about family and healing, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the end, Pietro finally learns that he cannot protect his daughter by just hiding from the world or hovering over her. He accepts his grief and allows himself to move forward. The movie wraps up with a feeling of hope as he and Claudia build a new, stronger bond. They find a way to be happy again, showing that while the pain of loss never fully goes away, you can still find peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt stories about family and overcoming grief.
